content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

Selling Notion templates for crypto is a straightforward way for digital creators to monetize their skills without relying on conventional payment processors. By utilizing infrastructure like NOWPayments, which charges only 0.5% on transactions compared to the 10% fee from platforms like Gumroad, creators can retain more of their earnings. This is significant when considering that on 100 sales of a $97 product, you would retain an additional $921. This process not only provides financial benefits but also ensures that creators maintain ownership of their data and products, a fundamental shift in the digital commerce landscape.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The underlying architecture for selling Notion templates effectively utilizes a combination of free tools and services. At its core, you have hosting through platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, which provides a solid foundation for your online store. For payment processing, NOWPayments allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies without requiring buyer accounts, making transactions seamless. On the backend, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers handles order processing while you store product information in Supabase or Google Sheets. This stack functions as a cohesive unit, granting creators full control and reducing dependency on traditional payment gateways.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically tailored for digital creators operating in regions where mainstream payment services are restricted or unavailable. If you're selling digital products like templates, ebooks, or courses, the COREMERCH solution provides sovereignty over your commerce operations. The aim is to empower creators from Nigeria, Kenya, and other parts of the world to engage in global commerce without the barriers imposed by conventional payment systems. By leveraging this infrastructure, you gain complete control over your transactions, data, and earnings.
Retain more profits by switching to NOWPayments — only 0.5% fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The successful deployment of your digital store for selling Notion templates requires several key components that work in harmony. You start with a reliable hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for your storefront. Integrating NOWPayments allows you to accept cryptocurrency payments directly, ensuring low transaction fees and instant payment confirmation. On the backend, utilize Google Apps Script for order processing and Supabase for data management. Finally, leverage Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive for secure file delivery. Each component is free or low-cost, ensuring that your setup remains sustainable while maximizing profitability.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start selling your Notion templates today, first, choose a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages to set up your website. Next, create an account with NOWPayments to enable cryptocurrency transactions on your site. Load your products into Supabase or Google Sheets for easy order management. Configure Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to automate payment processing and file delivery. Finally, promote your store and share your templates with a global audience. For a comprehensive solution, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) from COREMERCH, which includes everything you need to establish your digital commerce infrastructure.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by using platforms like NOWPayments to accept cryptocurrency. This allows you to bypass conventional payment systems while retaining more earnings due to lower fees. With the right infrastructure, such as the COREMERCH sovereign stacks, you can own your data and fully control your sales process.
Automate your product delivery for immediate customer satisfaction.

If you're looking to explore more about establishing your own digital store, consider checking the Complete Builder Kit ($197) at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This kit provides all six blueprints and seven templates needed to build a fully functional digital commerce stack without platform dependency.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I start selling digital products without traditional payment processors?

You can start by leveraging NOWPayments, which allows you to accept cryptocurrencies directly. Combine this with a reliable hosting service and a backend for order management to create a seamless sales process.
What are the benefits of using NOWPayments over platforms like Gumroad?
NOWPayments charges only 0.5% on transactions compared to Gumroad's 10%, allowing you to retain a larger portion of your sales. This is crucial for maximizing your profits as a digital creator.
Can I automate product delivery for my Notion templates?

Yes, by using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, you can automate the product delivery process. This ensures that your customers receive their downloads immediately after purchase, enhancing their experience.
Is it possible to sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Absolutely. With the COREMERCH infrastructure, you can build your own online store and sell templates and fonts directly, keeping all your earnings and maintaining control over your business.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept for my digital products?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to cater to a wide audience. You can choose popular options like Bitcoin, Ethereum, or stablecoins like USDT for transactions.
